highlights.description: `@plexusone/shell` renders navigation in an application on `SessionProvider` alone

fixed.description: Sidebar items no longer require a `TenantProvider`: items without roles always show, and items with roles are hidden when no `TenantProvider` can check them

upgradeGuide.description: Use `@plexusone/shell` 0.2.3; the other packages are unchanged

highlights.description: `@plexusone/ui` loads: 0.2.1's exports named files its build does not write, so neither import nor require worked, and `@plexusone/shell` could not load

fixed.description: `@plexusone/ui` exports point at the ESM `.js` and CommonJS `.cjs` files the build writes
`@plexusone/chat` no longer exports a `styles.css` that nothing builds

infrastructure.description: The build checks that every package entry point loads with import() and require(), so CI fails on a broken export

upgradeGuide.description: Use `@plexusone/ui` 0.2.2; `@plexusone/shell` 0.2.1 accepts it through its `^0.2.1` peer range. Other packages are unchanged at 0.2.1

highlights.description: Every package has a README and links to its repository and documentation on npm

fixed.description: Package pages on npm showed no README, and five packages had no repository link

infrastructure.description: 0.2.1 is the first release published for every package; `@plexusone/api-client` 0.2.0 was the only 0.2.0 published

highlights.description: A session over the relying-party BFF in `@plexusone/auth`: `SessionProvider` and `useSession` read `/bff/session`, with memberships keyed by organization ID, a role per application, and the deployment's app catalog
Shell chrome for composed applications: a product switcher from the app catalog, a controlled organization switcher, a session profile menu, named slots, and a light, dark and system theme
Organization management pages and a chat package with AI SDK integration
Packages are published under the `@plexusone` scope, publicly, and require React 19

added.description: `SessionProvider`, `useSession`, `SessionClient`, `toSession`, `membershipFor` and `organizationLabel` in `@plexusone/auth`; sign-in is a redirect to the BFF and sign-out a same-origin POST
`ProductSwitcher` and the `switcherApps` rule: the current application first, then the catalog applications the person holds a role in for the current organization
`OrganizationSwitcher`, a controlled organization picker keyed by organization ID
Named slots in `Navbar` and `AppShell`: `brand`, `command`, `actions`, with `app`, `organizationId` and `onOrganizationChange` turning on the switchers, and `breadcrumbs` passed through
`ProfileMenu`: who is signed in, the current organization and the role in this application, the application's `profileItems`, and sign out; the navbar uses it under `SessionProvider`
`useTheme`, `ThemeToggle`, `applyStoredTheme` and `showThemeToggle`: light, dark and system themes applied as the `dark` class, surviving unavailable storage
Sun, moon and monitor icons in `@plexusone/ui`
`OrganizationMembersPage`, `OrganizationInvitationsPage` and `OrganizationSettingsPage` in `@plexusone/pages`, with the `MemberRole`, `OrgSettingsTab`, `OrgMember` and `OrgInvitation` types
`@plexusone/chat` with AI SDK integration
`@plexusone/ui`, the shared component library the shell is built on

changed.description: The npm scope is `@plexusone`, renamed from `@systemforge`
`UserMenu` no longer adds Profile and Settings links by default; pass them in `userActions`
Internal ranges are caret ranges on the released version, and every package publishes publicly

fixed.description: `Navbar`, `UserMenu` and `OrgSwitcher` render without an `AuthProvider` or `TenantProvider` instead of throwing
`AuthProvider` no longer re-fetches the user in a loop
React hooks errors in the ProductGraph telemetry hooks

documentation.description: A guide to composing applications in one build or on one host each, and sections on the session, switchers, slots, profile menu and theme
The `AppShell` props table lists the props it has
Specs moved to `docs/specs/initiatives/`, with INIT-SYSTEMFORGEWEB-001 for the shell foundations

tests.description: Session adapter, client and provider, both switchers, slots, profile menu and theme; tests resolve workspace packages to their source

infrastructure.description: The release workflow runs only when started by hand; packages are published with pnpm

upgradeGuide.description: Import from `@plexusone/*` instead of `@systemforge/*`, and use React 19
Pass Profile and Settings entries to `UserMenu` in `userActions` if you relied on the defaults
For a SystemForge relying party, wrap the application in `SessionProvider` and pass `app`, `organizationId` and `onOrganizationChange` to `AppShell`

highlights.description: Initial release of SystemForge Web component library monorepo
ProductGraph telemetry integration with session management and OTel compliance
Multi-tenant primitives with organization context and tenant isolation

added.description: Monorepo setup with pnpm workspaces and Turborepo
ESLint and Prettier configuration for consistent code style
Vitest testing framework configuration
GitHub Actions CI/CD workflows
Changesets for versioning and changelog generation
`@systemforge/auth` package with JWT/OAuth/OIDC authentication primitives
`@systemforge/tenant` package with TenantProvider and useOrganization hooks
`@systemforge/api-client` package with typed HTTP client utilities
`@systemforge/telemetry` package with TelemetryProvider, ErrorBoundary, and hooks
`@systemforge/design-tokens` package with CSS custom properties
`@systemforge/shell` package with AppShell layout components
`@systemforge/pages` package with default page components (404, 500, Loading)
ProductGraphAdapter with session management (30-min timeout) and event batching
ProductGraph hooks: ComponentPathProvider, useStateTracker, JourneyProvider
ProductGraph hooks: useScrollTracker, useClickTracker, useAPITracker, usePageLeaveTracker
ProductGraph adapter and hook exports with TypeScript types

documentation.description: MkDocs documentation site with Material theme
ProductGraph integration design documents (PRD, TRD, PLAN, TASKS)
